item.name: Retrieve the quote for a group quote intent

request.description: Retrieves the quote details for a `group_quote_intent`. Returns pricing information and a fresh PDF URL. Only available when status is `quote_available`.
Rejects a `group_quote_intent` when the employer decides not to proceed with the quote. Can only reject intents in `quote_available` status.

query.description: Filter by group ID
Filter by plan ID

Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `processing`, `action_required`, `awaiting_quote`, `quote_available`, `rejected`, `rejected_by_insurer`, `quote_expired`.
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.
